description.value:
You've mastered a signature banquet, the pinnacle of your culinary craft. Spending an entire long rest and 1,000 credits of rare ingredients, you can prepare a feast able to serve a number of creatures equal to twice your Critical Analysis ability modifier. Every creature who partakes gains the following:

  • It is cured of all poisons and diseases, and becomes immune to poison and disease.
  • It has advantage on Wisdom saving throws against being frightened.
  • Its hit point maximum and current hit points both increase by 2d10.

These benefits last until the creature's next long rest ends, or 24 hours pass, whichever comes first. Droids and constructs gain nothing from this feast.
